```{ojs}
//| output: true
lpGlobe = {
  const SIZE = 440;
  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const quakes = lpQuakes || [];
  const now = Date.now();
  const DAY = 864e5;

  const wrap = html`<div class="lp-globe-wrap"></div>`;
  const canvas = html`<canvas width=${SIZE * dpr} height=${SIZE * dpr} role="img"
    aria-label="Spinning globe showing every magnitude 2.5 and larger earthquake from the past 7 days, from the USGS live feed. Most dots line up along plate boundaries, like the Ring of Fire around the Pacific Ocean."></canvas>`;
  const info = html`<div class="lp-globe-info" aria-live="polite"></div>`;
  const legend = html`<div class="lp-globe-legend" aria-hidden="true">
    <span><i style="background:#fde047"></i>Last 24 hours</span>
    <span><i style="background:#f97316"></i>Earlier this week</span>
    <span>Bigger dot = stronger quake</span></div>`;
  const src = html`<p class="lp-source">Live data: <a href="https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/map/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">USGS Earthquake Hazards Program</a>. ${reduceMotion ? "Drag" : "Drag to spin"}, or tap a dot.</p>`;
  wrap.append(canvas, info, legend, src);

  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
  const projection = d3.geoOrthographic().fitExtent([[6, 6], [SIZE - 6, SIZE - 6]], {type: "Sphere"}).precision(0.5);
  const path = d3.geoPath(projection, ctx);
  const graticule = d3.geoGraticule10();
  const R = projection.scale();
  const radius = m => 1.6 * Math.pow(1.65, m - 2.5) + 0.6;
  const ago = t => {
    const h = (now - t) / 36e5;
    if (h < 1) return "less than an hour ago";
    if (h < 24) return `${Math.round(h)} hour${Math.round(h) === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
    const d = Math.round(h / 24);
    return `${d} day${d === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  };

  // Headline count + default caption
  const strongest = quakes[quakes.length - 1];
  const countEl = document.getElementById("lp-quake-count");
  if (countEl && quakes.length) countEl.textContent = quakes.length.toLocaleString();
  const defaultInfo = () => {
    if (!lpQuakes) { info.innerHTML = "Live earthquake data couldn't load right now. Check back later!"; return; }
    if (!strongest) { info.innerHTML = "No earthquakes in the feed right now."; return; }
    info.innerHTML = `Strongest this week: <b>M${strongest.mag.toFixed(1)}</b>, ${strongest.place} (${ago(strongest.time)})`;
  };
  defaultInfo();

  // Start centered on the strongest quake so it's front and center
  let rotation = strongest ? [-strongest.lon, -Math.max(-35, Math.min(35, strongest.lat)) * 0.6] : [74, -20];
  let selected = null;
  let lastInteract = -Infinity;

  function draw(t) {
    projection.rotate(rotation);
    const [cx, cy] = projection.translate();
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, SIZE, SIZE);

    // Atmosphere glow
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, R * 0.92, cx, cy, R * 1.04);
    glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(56,189,248,0.35)");
    glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(56,189,248,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R * 1.04, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fill();

    // Ocean
    const ocean = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - R * 0.35, cy - R * 0.35, R * 0.1, cx, cy, R);
    ocean.addColorStop(0, "#1e4f8f");
    ocean.addColorStop(1, "#0a1f45");
    ctx.beginPath(); path({type: "Sphere"}); ctx.fillStyle = ocean; ctx.fill();

    ctx.beginPath(); path(graticule); ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(148,163,184,0.16)"; ctx.lineWidth = 0.6; ctx.stroke();

    if (lpLand) {
      ctx.beginPath(); path(lpLand);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#2f6f5e"; ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(226,232,240,0.35)"; ctx.lineWidth = 0.5; ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Quakes on the visible side of the globe
    const center = [-rotation[0], -rotation[1]];
    for (const q of quakes) {
      if (d3.geoDistance([q.lon, q.lat], center) > Math.PI / 2 - 0.02) continue;
      const [x, y] = projection([q.lon, q.lat]);
      const r = radius(q.mag);
      const recent = now - q.time < DAY;
      if (recent && !reduceMotion) {
        const phase = ((t / 1600) + (q.time % 1000) / 1000) % 1;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r + phase * 14, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(253,224,71,${0.7 * (1 - phase)})`; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fillStyle = recent ? "rgba(253,224,71,0.92)" : "rgba(249,115,22,0.72)";
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.6)"; ctx.lineWidth = 0.6; ctx.stroke();
    }

    if (selected && d3.geoDistance([selected.lon, selected.lat], center) < Math.PI / 2) {
      const [x, y] = projection([selected.lon, selected.lat]);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, radius(selected.mag) + 5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Soft shading on the night edge
    const shade = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - R * 0.3, cy - R * 0.3, R * 0.5, cx, cy, R);
    shade.addColorStop(0, "rgba(2,6,23,0)");
    shade.addColorStop(1, "rgba(2,6,23,0.45)");
    ctx.beginPath(); path({type: "Sphere"}); ctx.fillStyle = shade; ctx.fill();
  }

  // Drag to spin (mouse + touch)
  const toLocal = e => {
    const b = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return [(e.clientX - b.left) * SIZE / b.width, (e.clientY - b.top) * SIZE / b.height];
  };
  let dragStart = null, rotStart = null, moved = false;
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
    dragStart = toLocal(e); rotStart = rotation.slice(); moved = false;
    canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    if (!dragStart) return;
    const p = toLocal(e);
    const dx = p[0] - dragStart[0], dy = p[1] - dragStart[1];
    if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 4) moved = true;
    const k = 90 / R;
    rotation = [rotStart[0] + dx * k, Math.max(-70, Math.min(70, rotStart[1] - dy * k))];
    lastInteract = performance.now();
    if (reduceMotion) draw(0);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", e => {
    const p = toLocal(e);
    dragStart = null;
    lastInteract = performance.now();
    if (moved) return;
    // Tap: pick the nearest visible quake
    const center = [-rotation[0], -rotation[1]];
    let best = null, bestD = 22;
    for (const q of quakes) {
      if (d3.geoDistance([q.lon, q.lat], center) > Math.PI / 2) continue;
      const [x, y] = projection([q.lon, q.lat]);
      const d = Math.hypot(x - p[0], y - p[1]) - radius(q.mag);
      if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = q; }
    }
    selected = best;
    if (best) info.innerHTML = `<b>M${best.mag.toFixed(1)}</b> · ${best.place} · ${ago(best.time)}`;
    else defaultInfo();
    if (reduceMotion) draw(0);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", () => { dragStart = null; });

  // Animate only while the globe is on screen
  let timer = null, last = null;
  const tick = elapsed => {
    if (last !== null && !dragStart && performance.now() - lastInteract > 2500) {
      rotation[0] += (elapsed - last) * 0.006;
    }
    last = elapsed;
    draw(elapsed);
  };
  const start = () => { if (!timer) { last = null; timer = d3.timer(tick); } };
  const stop = () => { if (timer) { timer.stop(); timer = null; } };
  if (reduceMotion) {
    draw(0);
  } else {
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => e.isIntersecting ? start() : stop());
    io.observe(canvas);
    invalidation.then(() => { io.disconnect(); stop(); });
  }

  return wrap;
}
```

```{=html}
(function () {
  // Show a "pick up where you left off" link if last-visited.html saved one

})();
```

```{ojs}
//| output: true
lpStripes = {
  // NASA GISTEMP v4 annual global surface temperature anomaly (°C vs. 1951–1980), 1880–2025.
  // Same series as Unit 4's Earth–Sun Dynamics chapter.
  const anomalies = [-0.17,-0.09,-0.11,-0.18,-0.28,-0.33,-0.31,-0.36,-0.18,-0.11,-0.36,-0.22,-0.27,-0.31,-0.3,-0.23,-0.11,-0.11,-0.28,-0.18,-0.08,-0.16,-0.28,-0.37,-0.47,-0.26,-0.22,-0.38,-0.42,-0.48,-0.44,-0.44,-0.37,-0.34,-0.15,-0.14,-0.36,-0.46,-0.3,-0.27,-0.27,-0.18,-0.28,-0.26,-0.27,-0.22,-0.11,-0.22,-0.2,-0.36,-0.15,-0.09,-0.16,-0.28,-0.13,-0.2,-0.15,-0.03,0.0,-0.02,0.12,0.18,0.06,0.09,0.2,0.09,-0.07,-0.03,-0.11,-0.11,-0.17,-0.07,0.01,0.08,-0.13,-0.14,-0.19,0.05,0.06,0.03,-0.02,0.06,0.03,0.05,-0.2,-0.11,-0.06,-0.02,-0.08,0.05,0.03,-0.08,0.01,0.16,-0.07,-0.01,-0.1,0.18,0.07,0.16,0.26,0.32,0.14,0.31,0.16,0.12,0.18,0.32,0.39,0.27,0.45,0.41,0.22,0.23,0.31,0.45,0.33,0.47,0.61,0.38,0.39,0.53,0.63,0.62,0.53,0.68,0.64,0.66,0.54,0.66,0.72,0.61,0.65,0.67,0.75,0.89,1.01,0.91,0.85,0.98,1.01,0.85,0.89,1.17,1.28,1.18];
  const data = anomalies.map((a, i) => ({year: 1880 + i, a}));
  const W = data.length * 6, H = 150;
  const color = d3.scaleDiverging([-0.6, 0, 1.2], t => d3.interpolateRdBu(1 - t)).clamp(true);

  const wrap = html`<div class="lp-stripes"></div>`;
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`)
    .attr("preserveAspectRatio", "none")
    .attr("role", "img")
    .attr("aria-label", "Warming stripes: 146 vertical stripes, one per year from 1880 to 2025. Early years are mostly light blue; stripes turn red after about 1980 and are darkest red in the 2020s, showing Earth's average temperature has risen about 1.2 to 1.3 °C.");
  svg.selectAll("rect").data(data).join("rect")
    .attr("x", (d, i) => i * 6).attr("y", 0)
    .attr("width", 6.4).attr("height", H)
    .attr("fill", d => color(d.a));
  const marker = svg.append("rect")
    .attr("y", 0).attr("width", 6).attr("height", H)
    .attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", "#fde047").attr("stroke-width", 3)
    .attr("vector-effect", "non-scaling-stroke")
    .style("display", "none");

  const read = html`<p class="lp-stripes-read" aria-live="polite"></p>`;
  const show = d => {
    marker.attr("x", (d.year - 1880) * 6).style("display", null);
    const sign = d.a > 0 ? "+" : d.a < 0 ? "−" : "±";
    const word = d.a > 0 ? "warmer" : d.a < 0 ? "cooler" : "the same as";
    read.innerHTML = d.a === 0
      ? `<b>${d.year}:</b> right at the 1951–1980 average`
      : `<b>${d.year}:</b> ${sign}${Math.abs(d.a).toFixed(2)} °C ${word} than the 1951–1980 average`;
  };
  show(data.find(d => d.year === 2024));

  const node = svg.node();
  const pick = e => {
    const b = node.getBoundingClientRect();
    const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(data.length - 1, Math.floor((e.clientX - b.left) / b.width * data.length)));
    show(data[i]);
  };
  node.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { node.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); pick(e); });
  node.addEventListener("pointermove", e => { if (e.pointerType === "mouse" || e.buttons) pick(e); });

  wrap.append(node, read);
  return wrap;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Live USGS feed: every magnitude 2.5+ earthquake in the past 7 days.
// If it can't load, the globe shows no dots rather than made-up ones.
lpQuakes = d3.json("https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/feed/v1.0/summary/2.5_week.geojson")
  .then(feed => feed.features
    .filter(f => f.geometry && f.properties.mag != null)
    .map(f => ({
      lon: f.geometry.coordinates[0],
      lat: f.geometry.coordinates[1],
      mag: f.properties.mag,
      place: f.properties.place || "Unknown location",
      time: f.properties.time
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.mag - b.mag))
  .catch(() => null)
```
